description: AI-assisted grouping of a chat's turns into tasks. When off, grouping falls back to the fast keyword rule with no model calls. Takes effect immediately.
_note: App function (background service), not an agent ability. Its runtime lives in app/admin/tasks.py, which gates the LLM tie-breaker on ability_app_enabled('task_grouping'). Descriptor-only by design — no <id>.py.
